items.bwe: A single gigantic bucket wheel excavator in dull grey steel, built like a suspension bridge: on the far LEFT a big round dark rusty-brown bucket wheel ringed with many scoop buckets with teeth, at the end of a long straight horizontal steel lattice boom; in the CENTRE a heavy grey superstructure on a stack of short wide crawler tracks, and rising from it TWO VERY TALL steel lattice towers: one tall leaning A-frame tower and one even taller straight vertical pylon mast, both much taller than the boom is high; many straight parallel steel cables run from the tops of the two towers down to the wheel boom on the left and down to a short counterweight boom with a small machine house on the right; the whole machine is very wide, about twice as wide as it is tall
